acceptedAnswer.text: The process for scheduling a water-efficient bathroom upgrade with Hometelligent Inc. begins with an initial consultation to discuss your needs and preferences. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal and estimate. Once approved, we schedule the installation at your convenience. During the project, we ensure clear communication and a clean work environment, from initial assessment to project completion.
